title: The Mouse and the Lion
summary: This book tells the story of a small mouse and a mighty lion who become friends. They help each other and show that kindness and friendship are important, no matter how big or small you are.

texts: A hungry little mouse was looking for food in the forest.
But what the mouse found was not food—it was a lion!
The lion was a little hungry, too.
"You? A small mouse helping me? That's silly.
But I'm not very hungry, so I will let you go."
A few days later, the lion got caught with wire around his leg and couldn’t move.
Then the mouse ran over and said, "Lion, I will use my teeth to bite the wire and set you free."
And I’m sorry for not believing you."

preQuestions.question: What kind of relationship do the mouse and the lion have?

postQuestions.question: How did the mouse help the lion?

missions.title: Write a Friendship Story
missions.description: Think about the friendship and sharing in the story. Write or talk about a time you helped a friend, or when someone helped you.

vocabulary.definition: A big, strong cat that lives in the forest.
To make a loud, deep sound to scare others.
